fieldValues.title: Artist liability
fieldValues.context: The back stairwell cannot be locked — it is also a fire escape route. There is no practical mechanism to insure or protect work against theft or accidental damage in an open-access space.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Artists retain ownership of and responsibility for their own work. The project does not insure exhibited work. Artists are informed of this before agreeing to show.
fieldValues.rationale: Artists must make their own insurance decisions. The project is not in a position to take on liability for others' work and is not a commercial operation. Informing artists upfront keeps the arrangement honest.
